block_description: Advanced responsive flexbox grid based on Bootstrap 5 12-column layout (row, col-*) with customizable child columns supporting InnerBlocks.
columns_count_help: Choose between 1 and 6 active columns for your Bootstrap row.
quick_presets_help: Select a predefined layout to instantly configure the columns.
col_width_desktop_help: Bootstrap column class for large screens (LG). Default inherited by columns.
col_width_tablet_help: Bootstrap column class for medium screens (MD). Default inherited by columns.
col_width_mobile_help: Bootstrap column class for smartphones (default 12 columns = 100% width).
gutter_size_help: Controls Bootstrap 'g-*' classes for horizontal and vertical spacing between columns.
vertical_align_help: Aligns columns vertically inside the row via Bootstrap align-items-* class.
horizontal_align_help: Distributes columns horizontally in the row via Bootstrap justify-content-* class.
row_custom_class_help: Additional utility classes applied directly to the '.row' element.
column_custom_help: Override the default inherited Grid Flex width only for this specific column.
editor_guide_notice: Dashed borders and badges are visible only in the editor and will not appear on the live site.
